in_arabic.name: عماد
in_arabic.long_meaning: العماد هو اسم يعبر عن القوة والصلاح، ويأتي من الجذر العربي عماد الذي يعني العمود أو الدعم، وله أهمية كبيرة في التراث الإسلامي حيث يُعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الإيمان والاستقامة

in_urdu.name: عماد
in_urdu.meaning: عماد کا مطلب ہے ستون یا قوت
in_urdu.long_meaning: عماد ایک نام ہے جو قوت اور صلاحیت کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے، اور یہ عربي جڑ عماد سے اخذ ہوا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ستون یا سہارا، اور اس کا اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت ہے جہاں یہ ایمان اور استقامت کی علامت سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: एम्माद
in_hindi.long_meaning: एम्माद एक नाम है जो शक्ति और गुणवंता की ओर संकेत करता है, और यह अरबी मूल عمाद से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है स्तंभ या सहारा, और इसका इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व है जहां यह विश्वास और स्थिरता का प्रतीक माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: عماد
in_pashto.long_meaning: عماد د یو نوم دی چی قوت او صلاحیت ښودنه کیږی، او دا د عربي ریښې عماد څخه اخیستل شوی دی چی معنی یې ستون یا ساهار دی، او دا په اسلامی روایت کی ډیر महत밋 لری چی د ایمان او استقامت نیشانه بللی کیږی

data.cultural_impact: The name Emmad is of Arabic origin, and in Islamic culture, it holds a great deal of significance. The name is derived from the Arabic root word 'Amm' meaning 'Trust' or 'Faith.' Therefore, the name Emmad carries the meaning of being 'Reliable,' 'Trustworthy,' 'Truthful,' and 'Honest.' These virtues are highly valued in Islamic society and hold a significant place in the Quranic teachings. Thus, the name Emmad represents the ideal characteristics of an excellent human being and a good Muslim.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Emmad resonates with the steadfastness and reliability of the human soul on its spiritual journey. In the Islamic belief, the soul is considered to be a trust from Allah, and just as the name Emmad signifies trustworthiness in worldly matters, it can also signify the trustworthiness of the soul before Allah. Islamic teachings emphasize the importance of being truthful and honest in all actions and interactions, as these virtues help in drawing one closer to Allah and in building a strong bond with Him. Additionally, the name Emmad can represent the qualities of a strong believer, who unwaveringly puts their trust in Allah and strives to live in accordance with His guidance and teachings. Through this spiritual interpretation, the name Emmad serves as a reminder for Muslims to remain steadfast in their faith, to be truthful and honest in their dealings, and to always seek Allah's pleasure above all else.

historical_references.context: He was a prominent scholar during the Almohad Caliphate and is known for his significant contributions to Islamic jurisprudence and theology.

historical_references.reference: Emmad al-Din Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Jazari, a Turkmen engineer and inventor, lived during the Ayyubid Period, around 1136-1206 in Mosul, Mesopotamia.
historical_references.context: He is renowned for his many technological inventions, including the first programmable pottery wheel, water clocks, and various types of water distribution systems.
